text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Hah... Hah...
Haaaaaaaah...!!
choice_data_list: Last one! Don't let your guard down—!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: My full-scale training with Almond Eye began.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The training regimen prepared for her Make Debut
was intense, designed to further enhance her formidable physical capabilities, but—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh.
Phew...!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
No problem!
Let us continue!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Almond Eye follows my instructions well, giving her all to every single training session. Furthermore—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
—See you tomorrow at 15:00, then.
Good work today!
choice_data_list: Today was tough, so get some good rest.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'll make sure to rest later.
Excuse me, I'll be taking my leave now!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Phew... phew...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, I can still keep going.
One more lap at this exact same pace!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She never skips her self-training and constantly hones herself during her free time.
Her dedication is truly astonishing."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And it seemed that wasn't just true for me—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Gnugh... grrr... grrrrrr...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
~~...!!
...At MAX resistance, it pushes back quite a bit, doesn't it?
choice_data_list: Should we bring it down one more level?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm fine!
Once I take a break, let me try one more time.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: B！　C！　A！　A！

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Drink it right now!
Take good, good care of your body~~!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Well? You're supposed to drink it right after working hard, right?
Did it take away the sluggishness? Are you Hyper Ai-chan now?
choice_data_list: (I think she's got the wrong idea about the effects...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fusaichi Pandora. A GⅠ Umamusume
who once won the Queen Elizabeth II Cup...
in other words, an incredible girl, but――

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I mean, wouldn't real fruit cheer me right up?!
Should I beg Daddy for a melon~?!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I-I'm fine!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Lately, for some reason, she has been watching over
Almond Eye's training and occasionally brings refreshments like this.
choice_data_list: You came again today, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Totes!
I mean, of course I'm worried!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Because, because, Ai-chan is such a hard worker, right?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
If I push myself too hard, I'll be totally exhausted, won't I?!
Waaah...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Almond Eye has tremendous mental fortitude, which allows her to push herself far too hard. Because of that, she has collapsed in the past.
choice_data_list: (That's been on my mind too, but—)
(That's been on my mind as well, but—)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Miss Pandora, don't worry!
I'll be just fine!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I know myself best, after all. I'm used to dealing with it, so it's totally fine, totally fine!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Fweh~...
Buttt...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll show you I'm perfectly fine!
Trainer, let's resume!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah!
...Ai-chan, you're way too stoic~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Almond Eye is extremely stoic.
She has her own established methods for self-care.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still, the workload will only increase towards her debut.
Doing things the same as before might lead
to unforeseen situations...
choice_data_list: (In that case, what I should do is—)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
—Will you watch over
my independent training too?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I want to keep you company as much as possible from now on.
Yeah, I'd like to accompany you as much as possible from now on.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
As much as possible...? Meaning everything from now on?
Why go that far...?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, you mean the story about Pandora earlier!
Aren't you two being a little overprotective?
choice_data_list: Because you're such a super hard worker
Because you're such a super hard worker

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If I keep watching her at all times, I can make an overall judgment and draw the line.
If I handle her care, she can focus entirely on training.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...That's not really self-training anymore,
it's just a regular workout."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Besides... you must know that if you hang around me, you won't have any free time left for yourself, right?
choice_data_list: I know. In fact, that's what I want to do.
I know. In fact, that's what I want to do.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She is brimming with potential. However,
I am merely a rookie Trainer with no skills to speak of.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In that case, what I can offer her... right now, is basically just my time. And dedicating that to her means—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Because I have to catch up to her, knowing she'll keep growing stronger and stronger from here on.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Got it! In that case,
I'll let you know whenever I do independent training!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, but you should assume
you won't have any private time for a while.
choice_data_list: No problem! I'm counting on ya!
Of course! I'm counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I'm going to get changed now.
Good work today!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: *staaaaaaaare...*

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Is it just me, or does Trainer look kinda stressed?
Could it be that Ai-chan's facing a critical moment?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Or rather than me...
Maybe it's Trainer who's like that?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Oho~...
...Worried?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
No. Because I'm sure right now...
is that very moment.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Trainer!
It's rather chilly today, isn't it...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you look sleepy! You're going to ride your bike, right?
Come on, perk up!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A light pat on the back from Almond Eye
forces my eyes open. And so, her early morning
independent training begins—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —Good work! That's all for this morning.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Between waking up early when I'm not used to it and pedaling that bike like crazy, my head just isn't working properly...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Aren't you going to ice it for me?
choice_data_list: ! Sorry, I'll do it right away...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Hk, phew...
Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: "Thank you so much for the training today!"
choice_data_list: Good work. Are you doing self-training after this?
Good work. Are you going to do self-training after this?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I've kept today's training load light.
It's meant to balance out the week, but seeing how you are, we might be able to add a bit more.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...No, I'll pass!
My legs are feeling a bit heavy.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: If I take a soak in the bath and get a good night's sleep, I'll be fine. It won't affect tomorrow's training, so there's no need to adjust anything!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Ah, but... do you happen to know any professional care methods?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ever since signing a contract with Almond Eye,
I've been studying physical care and came across
a massage that seemed very promising.
choice_data_list: —...is the method I read about in a paper.
—...is the method I read about in a paper.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Ah, I've tried that before!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
That European academic paper on applied physiology, right?
Indeed, I feel like it suited me well.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Still, doing it alone was quite difficult.
If you'd be willing to help me, perhaps I could give it another try?"
choice_data_list: (...I've still got a long way to go.)
(...I still have a long way to go, huh?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Simply "spending time" isn't nearly enough.
I have to keep up with an Umamusume's stamina while acquiring
specialized knowledge, drawing closer to her very senses.
choice_data_list: (I should keep studying up on being a Trainer at the same time...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There's certainly no personal time at all.
I'll probably have to cut back on sleep too...
Still, if I want to catch up to her—
choice_data_list: No choice but to do it!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Oh?
Good morning. You're up early today.
choice_data_list: Yeah, I was just out for a little run.
Yeah, I was just out running.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Breaking curfew... wait, that's right,
you don't have one, do you, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu. You're full of energy, aren't you!
Well then, make sure you keep up!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, those whirlwind days passed by...
until a rest day finally arrived.
I thought I had gotten plenty of sleep the night before, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Between accompanying solo training and preparing daily workouts... actively attending seminars left no time to rest day after day.
choice_data_list: ...Maybe I'm being a bit too reckless...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Tremble tremble...)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Trainer, over here!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Here, write your name here.
—It's a sign-up sheet for the yoga class!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
*Inhale*... *phew*...!
It's the season of fresh greenery, isn't it...?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Moving around in here
would definitely feel amazing!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"You're already here, so you might as well enjoy yourself to the fullest!
Come on, it's about to start!"

text_block_list.name: Yoga Instructor
text_block_list.text:
—Let's stretch out our sides while taking deep breaths.
Breathe in deeply... and breathe out...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Phew... *sigh*...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Beside her, our breaths synchronize.
Taking deep breaths amidst the greenery and stretching out stiff muscles...
even our minds feel refreshed.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
Judging by your face, looks like you got refreshed!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainer.
My body feels so light right now."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
A little bit of training
shouldn't hurt, right?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Because—I really want to do my best.
When you feel that way, you should give it everything you've got, right?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Those feelings are precious, after all!
If that's what your heart says, you have to respect it.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Now that I'm refreshed, I can give it my all again!
Will you accompany me for training too?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Just a little longer until the debut! Let's race right through it~!
